name: Paphos
line: Paphos was a city on the island of Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas met a Roman governor who believed, before they sailed on to Perga.

moments.title: Paul faces Elymas
moments.text: At Paphos, the Roman governor, Sergius Paulus, wanted to hear God's word, but the sorcerer Elymas tried to turn him from the faith. Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, said Elymas would be blind for a time, and darkness came over him at once.

moments.title: Sailing from Paphos
moments.text: Paul and his companions set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. There John left them to return to Jerusalem.
